# Native result semantics evidence

The maintainer ran the standalone Panorama-Trace-Probe in the client and
supplied session mvbsz986-1 on October 17, 2026. The exact raw packet and hash
are retained here. Its owned-tree topology and ordered results distinguish
preorder, breadth-first and per-parent direct-children-first recursion.
The regression validates both plain and instrumented simulator results against
this packet, not against a second implementation of the same model.

Source was supplied by the diagnostic repository. The packet does not identify
the compiled binary or game build. It is controlled capability/result evidence,
not an original-mod trace, native internal visit count or FPS measurement.
